# Offset tests (C3; speed metric T95; generated by stats.py)

delta = gap*(m) - gap*(2): how much faster (in log2 units of isolated learning time) the complex feature must be, relative to the linear control, before the network is indifferent. delta < 0 is a residual simplicity preference. Bootstrap: 2000 resamples of seeds (joint and isolated runs) within cells. SESOI = 0.5 log2 units (a 1.41x speed ratio). p_holm: Holm-adjusted within each (experiment, depth) family of four tests. 'pooled' = mean offset over both optimisers and m = 3, 5.

## Main analysis (validity rule: isolated runs must reach 95% train and 95% test accuracy)

| exp | depth | optimiser | m | delta | 95% CI | 90% CI | p | p_holm | slope ratio b(m)/b(2) [95% CI] | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C3 | 3 | sgd | 3 | -0.15 | [-0.27, -0.07] | [-0.26, -0.09] | 0.005 | 0.014 | 1.00 [0.86, 1.17] | simplicity offset (CI < 0); negligible (90% CI within +-0.5) |
| C3 | 3 | sgd | 5 | -0.22 | [-0.37, -0.02] | [-0.35, -0.06] | 0.036 | 0.036 | 1.60 [1.17, 5.15] | simplicity offset (CI < 0); negligible (90% CI within +-0.5) |
| C3 | 3 | adam | 3 | -0.30 | [-0.44, -0.19] | [-0.42, -0.21] | 0.001 | 0.002 | 1.48 [1.26, 2.36] | simplicity offset (CI < 0); negligible (90% CI within +-0.5) |
| C3 | 3 | adam | 5 | -0.15 | [-0.28, -0.06] | [-0.26, -0.08] | 0.005 | 0.014 | 1.87 [1.48, 2.55] | simplicity offset (CI < 0); negligible (90% CI within +-0.5) |
| C3 | 3 | pooled | 3,5 | -0.21 | [-0.29, -0.14] | [-0.28, -0.15] | 0.001 |  |  | simplicity offset (CI < 0); negligible (90% CI within +-0.5) |
